À l'attention de la Section 4.\n\nLe bed:
For the attention of Section 4.

The sexton of Saint-Roch parish, Tomas HRUBY, rings the bells at hours that belong to no service: Monday 3 November at 10:40, Thursday the 6th at 14:15, Wednesday the 12th at 9:30. No service was planned at those hours.

A bell can be heard throughout District 2, and as far as the station. One does not ring for nothing. I ask who is listening, and what they are being told.

I have, in this matter, no personal interest. I am doing my duty, as for Saint Agatha.

I. KOLB
